caption: An avant-punk art-rock collision where a misplaced object triggers an ownership transfer, a false taxonomy of migratory minerals, and a phase threshold. Driven by 3:2 cross-rhythms, choral counterpoint, dial-up modems, and obsessive pharyngeal-trilled phonetics exploring spatial cognitive loss, phantom weight retention, and sensory ghost feedback loops across fractured dimensions of reality while questioning the basic nature of physical possession and control over everyday items.
